node.text: Remember when “Lush Life” started climbing the charts again? It happened right after Julia jumped onstage at Zara Larsson’s Amsterdam show and clips of her dance went super viral. This is Most Viral Fan, a Spotify original series celebrating the internet’s most iconic fans. Full episode on Spotify’s YouTube.
